pages.text: Open both endpoint menus. Choose the same resource type, enable Extract at the source and Insert at the destination, then match the colors for item or fluid routing.
Check the extraction mode. Try Always Active while testing an isolated route. For signal-controlled transfer, follow the $(l:enderio:conduits/redstone)lever example$(/l) and check the signal color.
Temporarily test without a filter. Ensure the destination has capacity and accepts the item or liquid on its connected face. Test a single route before checking priority and round robin.
